nodes.label: Palace
nodes.description: Ordered collection of Rooms; each Room belongs to exactly one Palace.

nodes.label: Room
nodes.description: Render one Room at a time as a rectangular box with depth greater than width.

nodes.label: Locus
nodes.description: A memorized item whose full Text appears at one Position; higher Positions may exist in the shared database.

nodes.label: Stable Position identity
nodes.description: Integer address 1–26; gaps preserve spatial identity and may not shift later Loci.

nodes.label: Horizontal Slices
nodes.description: Three horizontal bands: floor junction, center height, ceiling junction.

nodes.label: Eight wall-slots
nodes.description: Four corners and four wall centers per Slice; Position=(wall-slot−1)×3+Slice.

nodes.label: Fixed Anchors and faint markers
nodes.description: Every supported Position retains an Anchor and a faint numbered marker, even without a Locus.

nodes.label: Billboard
nodes.description: Camera-facing overlay showing Locus Text, toggled by J.

nodes.label: Peg
nodes.description: Reusable mnemonic image linked to Loci; not rendered in this demo.

nodes.label: Review addenda take precedence
nodes.description: 2026-09-19 addenda override original cube, vertical-slice, copying, capacity, native-library and RoomImage wording.

nodes.label: Viewer capacity is 26 Positions
nodes.description: The database may hold more Loci; place 1–26, warn on skipped higher Positions, never renumber or clamp.

nodes.label: World-fixed Room orientation
nodes.description: Front, back, left and right never mirror or move when the camera turns.

nodes.label: Position 22 correction resolved
nodes.description: The current first Slice diagram already has 22 in its bottom-left corner.

nodes.label: Single Room Windows demo
nodes.description: A walkable rectangular memory-palace Room with 26 Anchors, WASD, mouse look and J text toggle.

nodes.label: Demo requirements addendum
nodes.description: Implementation and acceptance requirements supersede conflicting original plan wording.

nodes.label: Superseded early wording
nodes.description: Cube, vertical slices and copy/import are historical wording only.

nodes.label: Required --room argument
nodes.description: Select an existing Room through required --room <id>; reject missing or invalid IDs visibly.

nodes.label: Optional --db override
nodes.description: Default C:\tools\Data\palace.db, with optional arbitrary database path override.

nodes.label: Selected Room title
nodes.description: Display the selected Room title in the viewer.

nodes.label: Empty and missing Rooms differ
nodes.description: An existing empty Room displays all 26 empty markers; an unknown Room ID is a visible error.

nodes.label: Supported unique integer Positions
nodes.description: Place only integer Positions 1–26; out-of-domain or malformed Positions must be reported.

nodes.label: Lowest Id wins duplicates
nodes.description: Place the lowest Locus Id and visibly name every other skipped Locus at the duplicate Position.

nodes.label: Visible skipped-Loci warnings
nodes.description: Warn for overflow, null and duplicate Positions while continuing to render valid Loci. Never silently discard, clamp or renumber.

nodes.label: Preserve missing Positions
nodes.description: Map by Position value, never query result ordinal; Anchor 9 may remain empty while Locus 10 stays at Anchor 10.

nodes.label: Visible loading errors
nodes.description: Useful errors for missing arguments, invalid or unknown IDs, missing or unreadable files, incompatible schemas and database failures.

nodes.label: Shared database unchanged
nodes.description: No repair, migration, schema creation, editing, or writes to test acceptance cases.

nodes.label: Record coordinate convention first
nodes.description: Record diagram front edge and viewing direction, world axes, dimensions, camera start position and facing before implementation.

nodes.label: Depth exceeds width
nodes.description: Rectangular Room with depth greater than width; exact dimensions are an implementation decision.

nodes.label: Obvious front-wall cue
nodes.description: Make the fixed front wall visually identifiable.

nodes.label: Centered floor and ceiling Anchors
nodes.description: Position 25 is floor center; Position 26 is ceiling center.

nodes.label: Exact wall Position diagrams
nodes.description: Diagram bottom edge: 22/23/24 left corner, 1/2/3 center, 4/5/6 right corner. Right-center 7/8/9; top-right 10/11/12; top-center 13/14/15; top-left 16/17/18; left-center 19/20/21.

nodes.label: Fixed-height walking with wall collision
nodes.description: WASD moves relative to horizontal camera facing; no flight or jumping; camera pitch never changes eye height and movement stays inside walls.

nodes.label: Mouse capture and release
nodes.description: Mouse controls look, Escape releases capture, and a viewer click recaptures.

nodes.label: Tune speed and look limits
nodes.description: Define and visually tune movement speed, mouse sensitivity and vertical look limits.

nodes.label: Label3D initial candidate
nodes.description: Initial camera-facing text implementation uses Godot Label3D billboarding and wrapping.

nodes.label: J toggles populated text
nodes.description: Initially hide all populated Billboards; each press of J toggles text, independently of markers.

nodes.label: K toggles numbered markers
nodes.description: Show faint numbered markers for all 26 Positions initially; K toggles markers independently of J.

nodes.label: Inward text offsets
nodes.description: Keep logical Anchors fixed while offsetting rendered text to avoid intersections with walls, corners, floor and ceiling as it billboards.

nodes.label: Full wrapped readable text
nodes.description: Choose wrap width, font size, contrast and distance scaling together. Preserve text without silent truncation or assuming a permanent maximum length.

nodes.label: All 26 Billboard visual checks
nodes.description: Inspect floor/ceiling while pitching, corners from multiple walking positions, longest current text, longer wrapping sample, and overlap/clipping with all 26 enabled.

nodes.label: Deferred features
nodes.description: No RoomImage, Peg rendering, database editing, learning-session recording or inter-Room navigation in the first demo.

nodes.label: Schema is reference transcription
nodes.description: Pasted schema contains wrapped comments that break executable SQL; restore comments before making an isolated fixture and never execute it against shared data.

nodes.label: Dated database observations
nodes.description: 2026-09-19 snapshot: 20 Rooms, 369 Loci; Room 7 had 1–29; Room 8 had 1–26; text lengths 4–117; no null, duplicate or gap Positions found. Recheck demo data.

nodes.label: Three-stage build order
nodes.description: First layout/markers/controls; then Billboards and wrapping samples; finally validated read-only database integration and Windows export.

nodes.label: Full Room acceptance
nodes.description: Every Locus appears at its numbered Anchor and the Room title displays.

nodes.label: Partial, gapped and empty acceptance
nodes.description: Partial Rooms and gap fixtures preserve identities; empty Room retains all 26 markers.

nodes.label: Overflow, null and duplicate acceptance
nodes.description: Room 7 warns visibly with skipped 27–29; isolated null and duplicate fixtures warn while rendering valid Loci.

nodes.label: Failure paths never create or mutate data
nodes.description: Useful loading errors without database creation or existing record changes.

nodes.label: Movement and text-toggle acceptance
nodes.description: Verify walls, fixed eye height, mouse release/recapture, all 26 readable from suitable positions, and repeated J affects text only.

nodes.label: Standalone Windows export acceptance
nodes.description: Test exported application as well as editor: packaged SQLite, --db override, no dependency on editor or C:\tools\e_sqlite3.dll.

nodes.label: Isolated validation fixtures
nodes.description: Exercise invalid and synthetic cases in separate test databases; never modify shared palace.db.

nodes.label: Godot .NET with direct SQLite
nodes.description: Godot 4 .NET/C# reads palace.db directly at load time through Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.
nodes.rationale: Reuse the existing .NET tooling ecosystem without an engine-specific SQLite addon or drift-prone JSON export.

nodes.label: Database ADR addendum
nodes.description: Direct SQLite and C# remain; previous claims of an existing override, shared native DLL dependence and RoomImage loading are superseded.

nodes.label: Explicit Mode=ReadOnly
nodes.description: Prefer SqliteConnectionStringBuilder, with explicit ReadOnly so an invalid path cannot create an empty database.

nodes.label: Parameterized Room query
nodes.description: Parameterize Room Id and load selected Room title and Loci.

nodes.label: Promptly dispose snapshot connection
nodes.description: Load once and promptly dispose database connection; no continuous refresh or per-frame queries.

nodes.label: Package-managed native SQLite
nodes.description: Use Microsoft.Data.Sqlite with SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 and its packaged native runtime assets.

nodes.label: Pin exact Windows toolchain
nodes.description: Record exact Godot .NET editor, matching export templates, .NET SDK, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite version and initial Windows architecture before implementation.

nodes.label: Godot .NET and SDK prerequisites
nodes.description: Development needs the .NET edition of Godot and .NET SDK.

nodes.label: Test alternate database path
nodes.description: Windows export must load an external database path with its own SQLite native dependency and no editor/shared-DLL requirement.

nodes.label: Rejected integration alternatives
nodes.description: GDScript + godot-sqlite addon and offline JSON export were rejected.
nodes.rationale: GDExtension adds a vendored engine-specific binary; offline JSON adds a build stage and second data copy.
